Anupāya announced: the means-less, first word of unceasing highest-recognition-nature.

Rite-yoga undeserves means-hood; distinctly discerned.
Awareness-means: luminosity in self-luminous — how from another?

Pleasure, pain, bondage, release: pot-and-jar same-meaning.
Unlit part: radiance? obliterated duality.
Non-shining: reality? luminance-specificity unapproved, follows.
One luminance well-established; warded off from afar.
Mere luminance, not number: bearing consciousness-difference.
Not śakti resting on another; not śakti-possessing god resting on anyone.
Not meditated, not meditator, not worshipful, not worshipper.
Not mantra, pronouncer, Lord, initiation, initiator, initiated.
No place-seat-rule here: doer-deed-act abandoned.
Neither being nor non-being, both-abandoned: hard to know, unsurpassed.

Non-being, non-shining nowhere useful; universe's life luminance-natured.

Rooted-knowledge-truth-purified on the anuttara path, means-unruled.
Of them, this shines everywhere, melted in consciousness-Bhairava-fire.
Pleasure-pain-share-doubt-fear notions, nirvikalpa-entry-only-remainder.

All-restraint-break-marks-bearing, not beyond grace, in remaining conduct, no purpose.
Own to be done; from effort not, for others' sake; but if stain-destroyed, Bhairavī-full.
Him who see by that form-order, stainless-aware: they too, of his form, grace-naturedness.

From altar higher, loom northward, cloth, meditation, dhāraṇā higher.

According to the graced one, varied, taught through Parāparā-means-flood-mixedness.

In venerable Ūrmi great-scripture, Siddha-lineage-shaped: told, so, by Somānanda and teachers.
From guru's word, assurance, arisen, told; when dissolved, in the doubt-cloud, that heart-sky-shining-greatness, of the Lord, sun-like, touching, feet darkness-conquering.
This anuttara-abode-discerning, means-shed, made: the ahnika.
